subject.title: [Feature]: Show running background tasks in the web Control UI

question: Should OpenClaw add a standalone Control UI Tasks ledger now, or fold this visibility/cancel surface into broader dashboard/workboard planning?
rationale: The implementation is feasible from existing seams, but it adds a new visible page and gateway event surface and overlaps partially with broader long-running automation dashboard work.

options.title: Add Narrow Tasks Ledger
options.body: Implement the standalone task ledger page and `task` broadcast as a bounded operator UI over the existing task registry.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Dashboard Work
options.body: Keep this issue open as part of the broader issue-to-PR/dashboard task visibility direction tracked by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/82776.

options.title: Keep CLI And Chat Surfaces Only
options.body: Decline the web page for now and leave task inspection/cancel to `openclaw tasks` and chat `/tasks`.

recommendation.title: Add Narrow Tasks Ledger
recommendation.body: Implement the standalone task ledger page and `task` broadcast as a bounded operator UI over the existing task registry.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent task-ledger and Control UI navigation work plus the protected label make steipete the strongest available decision owner.
